title: correlation-synthetic-data
summary: A research project modifying TabPFN-based synthetic tabular data generation so that columns are generated in an order driven by inter-column correlation. It wraps the standalone CTGAN package in a generator class, using CTGAN's mode-specific normalization as one of the synthetic-data baselines compared against the correlation-aware method.
evidence: model_wrappers/ctgan_generator.py:1 'from ctgan import CTGAN'; requirements.txt lists ctgan==0.11.0 and sdv==1.27.0
needs: sdv dependency listed in requirements.txt but no sdv import/call found in code; only standalone ctgan is used directly.
